description: Fail-closed admission authority for a rollback rehearsal. A historical candidate, branch head, tag or CI PASS cannot authorize rehearsal. Both source and rollback target must be distinct approved release-baseline records, and the target must already be rollback eligible. Admission records planning authority only; it never executes rollback, changes traffic or creates production evidence.
admissionGuards: source and rollback target release IDs are distinct approved records
source and target SHA and tag values exactly match their approved records
rollback target eligibility is ELIGIBLE or CONDITIONALLY_ELIGIBLE with verified true
all target eligibility conditions are explicitly copied into stop conditions
request input is external to the repository and repository working tree is clean
request uses an isolated non-production environment with production traffic forbidden
automatic destructive down migration and automatic traffic promotion are forbidden
retained parser artifacts and exact object-version evidence are referenced

all entry-criteria, recovery-point, forward-fix, artifact and human approval evidence references are tracked repository-contained regular files with no symlink components and working bytes equal exact HEAD at admission

every admitted request stores append-time SHA-256 digests for all entry-criteria, recovery-point, forward-fix, artifact and human approval evidence references and historical validation rejects later byte drift
Release Owner and Database Recovery Owner are distinct pseudonymous approvers whose typed approval documents are bound to the exact rehearsal ID and approved release pair
typed approval documents must record APPROVED and keep production traffic, production credentials and automatic promotion false
rehearsal ID and release-pair request are unique
registry update uses the canonical exclusive append lock and atomic replacement
registry append revalidates the canonical append-only authority after atomic replacement and restores the original registry bytes on failure
